WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HASH ORDER BY ClasssYear DESC) AS RowNum
    FROM Accumulated_Data
)
SELECT HASH,ID  ,StudentName , StudentStreet , StudentBolsaFamilia , StudentGender , StudentColor , StudentDeficiency , StudentBirthday , StudentNeighborhood ,
StudentCep , StudentBus , StudentAddressCity , StudentMotherName, StudentFatherName , StudentLocality , SchoolId , LogDate 
FROM CTE
LEFT JOIN F_Student sf
ON CTE.HASH = sf.F_HASH
WHERE CTE.RowNum = 1 AND sf.F_HASH IS NULL;

WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SchoolName ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS RowNum
    FROM Accumulated_Data
)
SELECT SchoolId, SchoolName ,SchoolAddress ,SchoolNumber , SchoolCep , SchoolComplementAddress , SchoolComplementNeigborhood  ,SchoolLatitude , SchoolLongitude  
FROM CTE
LEFT JOIN D_School dc on CTE.SchoolId = dc.ID  
WHERE RowNum = 1 AND dc.ID IS NULL ;

SELECT ad.HASH, ad.Class, ad.StudentStage, ad.StudentSerie, ad.ClasssYear, ad.StudentStatus
  FROM Accumulated_Data ad
  EXCEPT
  SELECT dc.F_HASH, dc.Name, dc.Stage, dc.Serie, dc.Class_year, dc.Status
  FROM D_Classroom dc

SELECT 
    ad.HASH,
    ad.StudentHasCeliac,
    ad.StudentHasDiabetes,
    ad.StudentHasHypertension,
    ad.StudentHasIronDeficiencyAnemia,
    ad.StudentHasSickleCellAnemia,
    ad.StudentHasLactoseIntolerance,
    ad.StudentHasMalnutrition,
    ad.StudentHasObesity,
    ad.StudentDiferentHealthProblems,
    DATEADD(HOUR, -3, SYSDATETIME()) AS LogDate
FROM 
    Accumulated_Data ad
JOIN 
    D_Student_health dsh ON ad.HASH = dsh.F_HASH
WHERE 
    (ad.StudentHasCeliac IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasDiabetes IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasHypertension IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasIronDeficiencyAnemia IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasSickleCellAnemia IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasLactoseIntolerance IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasMalnutrition IS NOT NULL
    OR ad.StudentHasObesity IS NOT NULL
    OR (ad.StudentDiferentHealthProblems IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ad.StudentDiferentHealthProblems) <> ''))
    AND ad.LogDate > (
        SELECT MAX(dsh_inner.LogDate)
        FROM D_Student_health dsh_inner
        WHERE dsh_inner.F_HASH = ad.HASH
    )
GROUP BY 
    ad.HASH,
    ad.StudentHasCeliac,
    ad.StudentHasDiabetes,
    ad.StudentHasHypertension,
    ad.StudentHasIronDeficiencyAnemia,
    ad.StudentHasSickleCellAnemia,
    ad.StudentHasLactoseIntolerance,
    ad.StudentHasMalnutrition,
    ad.StudentHasObesity,
    ad.StudentDiferentHealthProblems;

select ad.HASH,ad.StudentVaccine, DATEADD(HOUR, -3, SYSDATETIME()) AS LogDate  
from Accumulated_Data ad
where Vaccine_id is not null and
ad.LogDate > (
        SELECT MAX(dsv.LogDate)
        FROM D_Student_vaccine dsv 
        WHERE dsv.F_HASH = ad.HASH
    )
group by HASH, StudentVaccine;

select ad.HASH, ad.DataLineageIngestion, ad.LogDate , ad.Database_name   
from Accumulated_Data ad 
where ad.LogDate > (
select max(dr.LogDate)
from D_Registration dr 
WHERE dr.F_HASH = ad.HASH
)
group by HASH, LogDate, Database_name  ,DataLineageIngestion;

select
	c2.nome as CONTRATO,
	f.nome as FORNECEDOR,
	tdc.nome as "TIPO DE CONTRATO",
	F.respresentante_legal as "REPRESENTANTE LEGAL",
	r.descricao as RUBRICA,
	rf.parcelas as PARCELAS,
	RF.data_inicial as `DATA INICIAL`,
	RF.data_final as `DATA FINAL`,
	rf.valor_total as "VALOR TOTAL",
	rf.workload as "QUANTIDADE DE HORAS",
	rf.unitary_value as "VALOR UNITÁRIO",
	c2.apoiadora as 'APOIADOR',
	cdc.valor_total as 'VALOR TOTAL DOADO PELO APOIADOR',
	c2.origem_publica as 'ORIGEM PUBLICA',
	c.nome as 'Categoria Dos Gastos',
	rf.ordem as RUBRICA_FORNECEDORES_ORDEM,
	f.cnpj as FORNECEDOR_CNPJ,
	f.cpf as FORNECEDOR_CPF,
	a.ordem,
	a.data,
	a.valor
from
	fornecedor f
join rubrica_fornecedores rf on
	f.id = rf.fornecedor_fk
join rubrica r on
	rf.rubrica_fk = r.id
join tipo_de_contrato tdc on
	tdc.id = f.tipo_de_contrato_fk
join categoria c on
	c.id = r.categoria_fk
join centro_de_custo cdc on
	cdc.id = r.centro_de_custo_fk
join contrato c2 on
	cdc.contrato_fk = c2.id
join atividade a on
	a.rubrica_fornecedores_fk = rf.id
order by
	trim(c2.nome) asc,
	trim(f.nome) asc,
	rf.data_final

select
	c2.nome as CONTRATO,
	f.nome as FORNECEDOR,
	tdc.nome as "TIPO DE CONTRATO",
	F.respresentante_legal as "REPRESENTANTE LEGAL",
	r.descricao as RUBRICA,
	rf.parcelas as PARCELAS,
	RF.data_inicial as `DATA INICIAL`,
	RF.data_final as `DATA FINAL`,
	rf.valor_total as "VALOR TOTAL",
	rf.workload as "QUANTIDADE DE HORAS",
	rf.unitary_value as "VALOR UNITÁRIO",
	c2.apoiadora as 'APOIADOR',
	cdc.valor_total as 'VALOR TOTAL DOADO PELO APOIADOR',
	c2.origem_publica as 'ORIGEM PUBLICA'
from
	fornecedor f
join rubrica_fornecedores rf on
	f.id = rf.fornecedor_fk
join rubrica r on
	rf.rubrica_fk = r.id
join tipo_de_contrato tdc on
	tdc.id = f.tipo_de_contrato_fk
join categoria c on
	c.id = r.categoria_fk
join centro_de_custo cdc on
	cdc.id = r.centro_de_custo_fk
join contrato c2 on
	cdc.contrato_fk = c2.id
where
	(rf.data_final) >= now() 
group by trim(f.nome)
order  by sum(rf.valor_total) desc
